subject: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The events occur on the 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters that he is upset the person he has known for a day is dead.
source_quote: Grygum mutters, “I am so upset that the person I have known for a day is dead!”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait screams at Jimjar to give him money because he is leaving now.
source_quote: Spiderbait screams at Jimjar, “Give me money. I am leaving now!”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar quiets Spiderbait down and reassures him that he’s more likely to live if he stays around.
source_quote: Jimjar quiets him down and reassures him that he’s more likely to live if he stays around.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir’s pleasant dream about what Monks dream about was interrupted.
source_quote: Zalthir, whose pleasant dream about what Monks dream about was interrupted, looks around, trying to figure out why everyone is in an uproar.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stands to attention, ready to kill, after hearing screaming.
source_quote: Then, hearing the screaming, he stands to attention, ready to kill.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks if they are under attack.
source_quote: “Are we under attack?”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar whispers that Yukyuk was murdered and Spiderbait is very upset.
source_quote: Shuushar whispers, “No. Yukyuk was murdered, and Spiderbait is very upset.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says they have no other option but to continue and be alert.
source_quote: Grygum looks around and says, “Well, we have no other option but to continue and be alert.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks otherwise about continuing without investigation and wants to figure out what happened.
source_quote: But Daz, who finds mysteries to be interesting, thinks otherwise. “I want to figure out what happened.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz questions Spiderbait about whether anyone would want Yukyuk dead.
source_quote: First, he questions Spiderbait. “Would anyone want him dead?”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait says Yukyuk was the kindest, gentlest goblin you could imagine and that they were pals.
source_quote: “Yukyuk was the kindest, gentlest goblin you could imagine. He and I were pals.”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait says Yukyuk had nothing of value other than the kindest heart.
source_quote: “Other than the kindest heart, no.”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait accuses Shuushar of murdering Yukyuk, claiming Kuo-toans go mad and kill.
source_quote: “I’ll tell you who I think it is - Shuushar. Kuo-toan’s go mad. And when they go mad, they snap, and then they kill people!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz lists known traits of party members including Buppido’s talk of the divine plan.
source_quote: Daz turns to Zalthir, Grygum, and Thorin - “What do we know? Buppido always talks about the divine plan. Sethir seems a bit off. Topsy and Turvy are lycanthropes. Jimjar makes bets all the time. Eldeth is trying to keep it together and make sure we all arrive in one piece. And Shuushar claims to have figured out the cure to Kuo-toan insanity.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar proposes heading to Sloobludop to meet the arch-cleric of the Seamother to cast zone of truth.
source_quote: Just then, Shuushar approaches them and says, “ I propose we head to Sloobludop, where we can meet the arch-cleric of the Seamother, who can cast the zone of truth, and we can learn what happened.”

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is the location of the arch-cleric of the Seamother.
source_quote: head to Sloobludop, where we can meet the arch-cleric of the Seamother

subject: Seamother
fact: The Seamother is a deity whose arch-cleric can cast zone of truth.
source_quote: arch-cleric of the Seamother

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum calls heading to Sloobludop the easy way out and prefers intelligence and deduction.
source_quote: Grygum mutters, “That’s the easy way out. Let’s do it the hard way by applying intelligence, deduction, insight, and perception.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz considers asking Buppido what happened.
source_quote: Daz shrugs, “I guess I could ask Buppido.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says Yukyuk’s death was all part of the plan.
source_quote: Buppido looks at Daz and says, “This was all part of the plan!”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says Yukyuk’s death was necessary for the divine plan.
source_quote: Buppido sweats, “Yukyuk’s death was necessary for the divine plan.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido evades responsibility for Yukyuk’s death by claiming he cannot be held accountable for the divine plan.
source_quote: Who can say? I cannot be held accountable for the divine plan.

subject: shortsword
fact: Buppido’s shortsword has blood on it from a victim.
source_quote: he examines his equipment and notices that the shortsword may have blood on it from a victim.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido protests that he’s not a maid and that’s why the shortsword has blood on it.
source_quote: Buppido tries to protest that he’s not a maid, and that’s why it’s got blood on it.

subject: mind-sliver cast on Buppido
fact: Daz casts a mind-sliver on Buppido and stares him in the eye.
source_quote: Daz gets annoyed and pushes past Buppido. He examines his equipment and notices that the shortsword may have blood on it from a victim. Buppido tries to protest that he’s not a maid, and that’s why it’s got blood on it. Daz is fed up, so he casts a mind-sliver on the derro, stares him in the eye, and makes it clear that it could get a lot worse.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “Ouch!! That hurt. It wasn’t me! It was the agent of the divine plan.”
source_quote: “Ouch!! That hurt. It wasn’t me! It was the agent of the divine plan.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, “That’s what they all say.”
source_quote: Grygum looks at him and says, “That’s what they all say.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido whimpers, “It’s not my fault.”
source_quote: “It’s not my fault,” Buppido whimpers.

subject: second mind-sliver cast on Buppido
fact: Daz casts another mind-sliver on Buppido, causing him to whimper even more.
source_quote: Another mind-sliver is cast, and the derro whimpers even more.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith tells Daz that his torture technique is excellent and offers more effective ones taught by Lolth’s guard.
source_quote: Sarith walks up to Daz and says, “That’s an excellent torturing technique. However, I have other more effective ones that I was taught as a member of Lolth’s guard. We could remove his eyes, nails, and other things.”

subject: Lolth’s guard
fact: Sarith was taught torture techniques as a member of Lolth’s guard.
source_quote: I was taught as a member of Lolth’s guard

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says he is not torturing Buppido; he is providing motivation.
source_quote: Daz looks at him, somewhat annoyed but somewhat pleased: “I am not torturing him; I am providing motivation.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir perks up and thinks he has never heard torture referred to as motivation.
source_quote: Zalthir perks up, “Motivation?” He thinks that in his many years, he had never heard anyone refer to torture as motivation.

subject: Zalthir reconsidering prohibition of torture
fact: Zalthir considers reconsidering his prohibition of torture.
source_quote: “Perhaps I should reconsider my prohibition of it.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “It wasn’t me.”
source_quote: “It wasn’t me.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realizes Buppido is mad, not merely holding a different perspective.
source_quote: Daz stares at him, wondering if he is mentally ill or just different. He has had enough experience with the judgmental overbrighters who assume all Drow are evil to be willing to give everyone a chance. But he realizes that this isn’t someone who has a different perspective; Buppido is mad.

subject: Daz decides to cut Buppido loose
fact: Daz says, “Let’s cut him loose.”
source_quote: “Let’s cut him loose.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says no to cutting Buppido loose and wants to tie him up to try his mental sanity techniques.
source_quote: Shuushar says, “No, no. I want us to tie him up. I can try my techniques of mental sanity on him as well!”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido looks genuinely horrified at the idea of being tied up.
source_quote: Buppido looks genuinely horrified.

subject: Buppido is gagged and tied
fact: Daz orders Buppido to be tied up and gagged if he cannot keep quiet.
source_quote: Daz turns to the derro, “We are going to tie you up, and if you can’t keep quiet, gag you.”

subject: Buppido’s position
fact: A gagged Buppido walks next to Shuushar.
source_quote: A few minutes later, a gagged Buppido walks next to Shuushar

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar talks endlessly about Kuo-toan-fulness.
source_quote: who talks endlessly about this technique called Kuo-toan-fulness.

subject: Kuo-toan-fulness
fact: Kuo-toan-fulness is a technique aiming to create a space between impulse and action to determine if the impulse is a reaction to reality or just a mental response.
source_quote: The goal is to create a space between the moment an impulse comes to your mind and the moment you take an action, and in that moment, wonder if that impulse is a reaction to the real world or just a response in your mind.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido pleads for a mercy killing.
source_quote: Buppido pleads for a mercy killing

subject: gag
fact: Buppido is gagged.
source_quote: a gagged Buppido
